budget_items.what_was_recorded: The three Fire Department capital requests were stated to total $700,000.
budget_items.quote: the three fire department capital requests total $700,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Replacement cost for the 2003 4x4 utility truck with plow, Priority #1.
budget_items.quote: 4x4 utility truck with plow (2003) $70,000 cost. priority #1.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Replacement cost for the 2007 command car, Priority #2, with the Chief estimating its trade-in value.
budget_items.quote: the chief plans to trade this in when it is replaced and he estimates its trade-in value at $4,000 to $5,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Replacement cost of Engine #4 stated as of 2016, with a 5% per year inflation factor; Priority #3.
budget_items.quote: engine #4 (1995) $575,000 as of 2016. inflation factor is 5% per year.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Maintenance on Engine #4 cost about $50,000 over the past three years.
budget_items.quote: it has cost about $50,000 over the past three years to maintain

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The pump may need replacing for an estimated cost of around $5,000 to $6,000.
budget_items.quote: the pump is showing signs of age and may need to be replaced for around $5,000 to $6,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The five School Department capital requests were stated to total $219,613.94, including a $14,000 used pick-up truck.
budget_items.quote: the five school department capital requests total $219,613.94. this total includes the used pick-up truck at $14,000

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The School Department and Technology Department withdrew a $10,000 capital request for servers.
budget_items.quote: the school department working with the technology department has withdrawn their $10,000 capital request for servers

budget_items.topic: THMS asbestos abatement (phase 1 of remaining stages)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Asbestos abatement at Turkey Hill Middle School requested at $145,000, Priority #1; the three remaining phases total $434,000, and $17,000 of FY15 funds remain unexpended.
Phone system replacement requested at $22,000, Priority #2; the system has an expected life of 15 years.

budget_items.topic: District HQ relocation heat pump/air conditioning
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Heat pump/air conditioning request stated at $16,613.94, Priority #4, which differs from the $15,000 in the School Department Capital Plan matrix because it includes a ten percent contingency.
budget_items.quote: the $16,613.94 amount here differs from the $15,000 shown in the school department capital plan matrix

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Used pick-up truck requested at $14,000, Priority #5; the schools may consider the Fire Department's utility pick-up as a lower cost alternative.
The three remaining phases would be funded independently and do not commit funding of subsequent phases in successive years.
budget_items.quote: if the town funds this phase it would not commit funding of subsequent phases in successive years
